description: Discover a USGS site’s parameters, sensors, statistics, and UTC record bounds before calling water_get_series. Find site numbers with water_find_sites. Each row is a distinct series; metadata bounds may contain gaps and lag observations. For water_get_series, take YYYY-MM-DD from beginDate/endDate, pass statCd only for daily rows, and obtain methodId from a water_get_series response; timeSeriesId is an OGC identifier, never an NWIS methodId. Rows with null seriesType are other computations and cannot be requested with water_get_series. Follow nextCursor with the same filters and limit until null.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; keep site, parameterCd, seriesType, and limit unchanged.

limit.description: Maximum metadata rows per page (1–1000; default 100). Keep unchanged when using cursor.

parameterCd.description: Optional 5-digit parameter code from water_list_parameters, e.g. "00060".

seriesType.description: Limit to Daily computations or Points/Instantaneous computations. Omit to include all periods.

site.description: USGS site number (8–15 digits), from water_find_sites; e.g. "01646500".

name: water_get_site_data_catalog

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The monitoring location does not exist. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed or belongs to different filters or page size. `upstream_timeout`: The upstream request or shared 45-second deadline expired. `upstream_error`: The OGC API failed or returned malformed location or metadata. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for the same filters and limit, or null when no next page exists.

series.description: One metadata page; distinct sensors/statistics remain separate. Empty when a known site has no matching rows.

beginDate.description: Full UTC first-observation bound, or null; take YYYY-MM-DD for startDate.

computation.description: Raw upstream computation (e.g. Mean, Instantaneous), or null.

computationPeriod.description: Raw upstream computation period (e.g. Daily, Points, Water Year), or null.

endDate.description: Full UTC latest-observation bound, or null; take YYYY-MM-DD for endDate. May lag observations.

parameterCd.description: USGS parameter code for this series.

seriesType.description: daily for Daily; instantaneous for Points with Instantaneous; null otherwise.

statCd.description: Statistic identifier, or null; pass only for daily water_get_series calls.

timeSeriesId.description: Distinct OGC time-series identifier; not an NWIS methodId.

unit.description: Upstream unit of measure, or null.

siteName.description: Upstream site name, or null when unavailable.

siteNumber.description: USGS site number, preserving leading zeros.

title: Water Get Site Data Catalog
